# League-2 Start/Sit Briefing -- Week 11, Saturday final call

**Source and freshness:** Committed fixture `weekly-report-week-11.json` (FantasyPros consensus + ESPN injuries + LLM news), generated 2026-11-17T18:47:14Z -- about 3.5 days old. Overlaid with a live `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` Week 11 pull (293 rows across 26 teams) and `load_player_stats(2026)` for Thursday's already-completed game. **Not live** for projections or news; the injury overlay is live and confirms no new designation for anyone on this roster with a game left to play. Thursday's IND @ HOU game is final (HOU 26, IND 3); Jonathan Taylor's actual result replaces his projection below.

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Bo Nix | vs LV | **17.82** | 0.974 | 18.29 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | at HOU (FINAL) | **6.70** | 1.000 | 6.70 (actual) |
| RB | Cam Skattebo | vs JAX | **15.56** | 0.922 | 16.88 |
| WR | Tee Higgins | at WAS (Mon) | **17.30** | 0.972 | 17.79 |
| WR | Jameson Williams | vs TB | **11.60** | 0.972 | 11.93 |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | vs JAX | **14.02** | 0.955 | 14.69 |
| FLEX | Bucky Irving | at DET | **15.93** | 0.959 | 16.61 |
| FLEX | Sam LaPorta | vs TB | **11.06** | 0.955 | 11.59 |
| K | Jake Bates | vs TB | **8.20** | 0.987 | 8.31 |
| DEF | Jets D/ST | at LAC | **4.96** | 1.000 | 4.96 |
| **Total** | | | **123.15** | | |

**Bench, sit:** Tyler Shough (QB, 16.25 -- below Nix). Jalen Coker (WR, 9.54 -- below both Williams and LaPorta for the open WR-eligible spot). Matthew Stafford, Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Drake London are all on bye.

**The headline isn't a decision, it's a result.** Jonathan Taylor's game is over. HOU beat IND 26-3, and Taylor finished with 11 carries for 21 yards and 4 catches for 6 yards -- no touchdown, 6.7 actual points under this league's real scoring. That's locked in regardless of anything below, and it's the entire reason the lineup total dropped from Wednesday's 130.10 to 123.15 -- not a new injury, not a lineup change, just a weak game already in the books.

## Changes since Wednesday (2026-11-18)

No lineup swaps. Every starter is the same player in the same slot as Wednesday's briefing. The only difference is informational: Taylor's Thursday result is now final (6.70 actual vs. 14.21 projected), which is why the total reads lower than Wednesday despite nothing changing hands.

## Watch list

- **League-wide final designations are running late.** As of this pull, every team but HOU/IND (already played) has filed only practice-participation rows for Week 11 -- no final game-status column has posted yet for any Sunday/Monday player on this roster. Nothing currently looks wrong, but recheck Sunday morning before the 1:00pm ET lock, especially for the early Sunday slate.
- **Tee Higgins** locks last (Monday 8:15pm ET) -- the most time of anyone in this lineup to react to news. Currently clean (Full Participation, no limitation).

## Opponent notes

- **TB @ DET (Sun 1:00pm)** is a four-player game for this roster: Irving (TB) against LaPorta, Bates and Jameson Williams (all DET). DET is a 5.5-point favorite with a 25.5 implied total to TB's 20.0.
- **JAX @ NYG (Sun 1:00pm)** stacks the other way: Skattebo and Likely both play for NYG, favored by 6 with a 26.25 implied total -- the best game-script spot in this lineup.
- Jets D/ST is on the road at LAC (LAC favored by 3) -- a middling matchup, but there's no bench alternative at DEF.

## Byes ahead

- **Week 13:** Jonathan Taylor (RB, IND) and the Jets D/ST (NYJ) share a bye, two weeks out. No waiver claim needed yet -- just a planning flag, same as flagged in prior briefings.

## Caveats

- Jonathan Taylor's Thursday result (6.70 actual) is final and cannot be changed by anything in this report; this assumes he was actually started before Thursday's kickoff, which cannot be verified against the live Sleeper app from static roster files.
- Every number above except Taylor's comes straight from the committed fixture; this run did not recompute projections.
- No lineup change vs Wednesday -- the 6.95-point total drop is Taylor's actual result, not new information about anyone else.
- 123.15 expected points across ten full-PPR starters is within the normal 100-140 range. Sanity check passed.
